netzero_separate.note: Whole-plant eia923_netzero lay-up rows, reported SEPARATELY: their unit_capacity_mw is the plant's total nameplate standing for a whole-plant lay-up, so they are a different object from the per-unit basis gap and are never aligned here (fail-closed).
